# Phoenix — animation 5

The six-pose transparent phoenix sheet was generated with built-in imagegen on October 19, 2026 and saved as phoenix6.png. The app uses local cached silhouettes, draws an orbiting fire ring and the defeated king's ashes, and ends with the phoenix alone. The starred king is shown only when animations are off. Confetti continues unchanged in both modes. Reduced motion displays the final pose; cancellation discards queued frames and asset-loading callbacks.

All ten game-end scenes are chosen independently with equal probability; repeats are allowed.

## Generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six-pose transparent sprite sheet for an ORIGINAL phoenix bird in a chess victory animation, exactly THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. True transparent RGBA background, no photographic or smoky backdrop, haze, floating glow, ground shadow, text, grid or scenery. Each bird must fit fully within its own equal cell with generous empty margins and no overlap. SAME magnificent phoenix in all six poses: anatomically coherent eagle-like bird with ruby-red breast, rich burnt-orange wings, warm gold flight feathers, small elegant head, curved golden beak, amber eye, and three flowing long red-gold tail plumes. Beautiful detailed realistic painted fantasy game art, refined luminous feather edges, readable at small miniature scale. No dragon features, no human face, exactly two wings, two short legs and one head. Solid connected feathers and tail; no separate fire particles or detached feather fragments, effects are added by the app. Consistent proportions, identity, body center, camera and size across cells. Fixed THREE-QUARTER SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT. Top row left to right: (1) flying with wings in a high upstroke, (2) gliding with wings extended nearly level, (3) flying with wings sweeping downward. Bottom row: (4) banking in a graceful turn with wings arched, (5) powerful upward wingbeat with tail curling behind, (6) proud upright victory pose with feet gathered underneath and both wings majestically half spread. Entire wings, tail, beak and feet visible, never cropped. Prefer landscape 1536x1024, no added objects or chess pieces. Keep genuinely transparent space around every intact silhouette.
